criteria.requirement: Build MappedJSONConfigFileParser(paths, *, unknown="error", duplicates="error") on the accepted JSON parser. paths maps explicit nonempty string tuples to unique flat action keys. Distinguish a literal dotted key from nested paths; reject prefix conflicts, duplicate destination keys, scalar/table conflicts, unsupported values and unknown leaves by default. Missing paths stay absent; unknown="ignore" is explicit. Scalars/lists must use the existing JSON conversion and actual ArgumentParser type/action pipeline. Serialize flat mapped settings back to the matching nested JSON object without changing inputs or allowing unknown output keys; preserve duplicate and finite-number controls.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
